label: Order
caption: VIVEK H. MURTHY, SURGEON GENERAL, ET AL. V. MISSOURI, ET AL.
text: UPON FURTHER CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, the response, and the reply filed thereto, IT IS ORDERED that the stay issued on September 14, 2023, is hereby extended until 11:59 p.m. (EDT) on Wednesday, September 27, 2023.
